title: Hookless
notes: Official page read 2026-11-01: from the 2025 range, all road tubeless-ready tires 700x28 mm and wider in the Blackbird, Blackbird Race, Blackbird All Season and Challenger lines are compatible with hooked and hookless rims if the maximum pressures are strictly respected; older lines (Fusion 5 Performance and All Season, Intensive, Sector, Equinox and others) are not hookless compatible unless the rim maker allows it.
